dialogue:a1-phone-choice-3.tr: Harf harf söylüyorum: V, O, S, S. Anlaşıldı mı?

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-4.de: Das weiß hier jeder, Herr Voss!
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-4.en: Everyone here knows that, Mr Voss!
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-4.tr: Bunu burada herkes bilir, Herr Voss!

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-5.de: Ich habe das Register vor mir. Gartenstraße sieben.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-5.en: I have the register in front of me. Gartenstraße seven.

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-6.de: Dort steht kein Name. Das ist nicht normal.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-6.en: There is no name there. That is not normal.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-6.tr: Orada ad yok. Bu normal değil.

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-7.de: Ihr Name ist auch nicht im Register.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-7.en: Your name is not in the register either.
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-7.tr: Sizin adınız da kayıt defterinde yok.

dialogue:a1-phone-choice-8.de: Wollen Sie Ihren Namen jetzt buchstabieren?
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-8.en: Do you want to spell your name now?
dialogue:a1-phone-choice-8.tr: Adınızı şimdi harf harf söylemek ister misiniz?

choice:a1-phone:spell.de: Ja, Herr Voss. Ich buchstabiere meinen Namen.
choice:a1-phone:spell.en: Yes, Mr Voss. I will spell my name.
choice:a1-phone:spell.tr: Evet, Herr Voss. Adımı harf harf söylüyorum.

choice:a1-phone:refuse.de: Nein, danke, Herr Voss. Der Name bleibt bei mir.
choice:a1-phone:refuse.en: No, thank you, Mr Voss. The name stays with me.
choice:a1-phone:refuse.tr: Hayır, teşekkürler, Herr Voss. Ad bende kalsın.

dialogue:a1-phone-complete-0.de: Das Telefon ist wieder ruhig. Geh zu Fritz.
dialogue:a1-phone-complete-0.en: The telephone is quiet again. Go to Fritz.

dialogue:a1-phone-complete-1.de: Er hat eine Frage für dich.
dialogue:a1-phone-complete-1.en: He has a question for you.

dialogue:a1-phone-after-spell-0.de: Danke. Langsam, bitte. Ich schreibe mit.
dialogue:a1-phone-after-spell-0.en: Thank you. Slowly, please. I am writing it down.

dialogue:a1-phone-after-spell-1.de: Jetzt steht dein Name im Register.
dialogue:a1-phone-after-spell-1.en: Now your name is in the register.

dialogue:a1-phone-after-refuse-0.de: Wie Sie möchten. Das Register wartet.
dialogue:a1-phone-after-refuse-0.en: As you wish. The register will wait.

dialogue:a1-phone-after-refuse-1.de: Dein Name bleibt bei dir. Das ist gut.
dialogue:a1-phone-after-refuse-1.en: Your name stays with you. That is good.

dialogue:a1-phone-topic-otto-0.de: Er ist bei der alten Laterne.
dialogue:a1-phone-topic-otto-0.en: He is at the old lantern.

dialogue:a1-phone-topic-otto-1.de: Auf Gleis sieben. Wie jeden Tag.
dialogue:a1-phone-topic-otto-1.en: On platform seven. Like every day.
dialogue:a1-phone-topic-otto-1.tr: Yedinci rayda. Her gün olduğu gibi.

dialogue:a1-phone-topic-register-1.de: Alles ist in Ordnung. Nur ein Name fehlt.
dialogue:a1-phone-topic-register-1.en: Everything is in order. Only one name is missing.
dialogue:a1-phone-topic-register-1.tr: Her şey yerli yerinde. Sadece bir ad eksik.

evidence:a1-phone:lindenhafen-cafe-recei.de: Das Telefon. Daneben liegen Rechnungen und Briefe.
evidence:a1-phone:lindenhafen-cafe-recei.en: The telephone. Beside it lie receipts and letters.
evidence:a1-phone:lindenhafen-cafe-recei.tr: Telefon. Yanında fişler ve mektuplar duruyor.

objective:a1-invitation:1.en: Look at the Friday list on the crate

objective:a1-invitation:3.en: Decide who sits in the empty chair
objective:a1-invitation:3.tr: Boş sandalyeye kimin oturacağına karar ver

dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-0.de: Da bist du ja! Ich koche am Freitag.
dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-0.en: There you are! I am cooking on Friday.
dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-0.tr: İşte buradasın! Cuma günü yemek yapıyorum.

dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-1.de: Jeden Freitag um sieben gibt es Suppe.
dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-1.en: Every Friday at seven there is soup.
dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-1.tr: Her cuma saat yedide çorba var.

dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-2.de: Alle kommen: Otto, Marta, Lina und Greta.
dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-2.en: Everyone comes: Otto, Marta, Lina and Greta.
dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-2.tr: Herkes geliyor: Otto, Marta, Lina ve Greta.

dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-3.de: Leider kommt Emil oft zu spät. Seine Maschinen!
dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-3.en: Unfortunately Emil is often late. His machines!
dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-3.tr: Maalesef Emil sık sık geç kalıyor. O makineleri!

dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-4.de: Ich habe zwölf Gläser. Elf Gäste.
dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-4.en: I have twelve glasses. Eleven guests.
dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-4.tr: On iki bardağım var. On bir misafir.

dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-5.de: Ein Glas ist zu viel. Immer.
dialogue:a1-invitation-intro-5.en: One glass is too many. Always.

dialogue:a1-invitation-gate-0.de: Du bist neu hier. Das ist gut.
dialogue:a1-invitation-gate-0.en: You are new here. That is good.

dialogue:a1-invitation-gate-1.de: Kommst du am Freitag um sieben?
dialogue:a1-invitation-gate-1.en: Will you come on Friday at seven?
dialogue:a1-invitation-gate-1.tr: Cuma günü saat yedide geliyor musun?

dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-1.de: Du hast schon Brot gekauft. Sehr gut!
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-1.en: You already bought bread. Very good!

dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-2.de: Du hast ihren Namen schon gesagt. Gut.
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-2.en: You have already said her name. Good.

dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-3.de: Bei uns sagt jeder alle Namen laut.
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-3.en: With us, everyone says all the names aloud.
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-3.tr: Bizde herkes bütün isimleri yüksek sesle söyler.

dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-4.de: So bleiben die Namen an meinem Tisch.
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-4.en: That way the names stay at my table.

dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-5.de: Dort ist ein Platz. Er ist frei.
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-5.en: There is a seat over there. It is free.

dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-6.de: Das ist der Platz von Frau Berg.

dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-7.de: Sie hat nie gefehlt. Bis jetzt.
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-7.en: She never missed it. Until now.

dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-8.de: Bleibt der Platz frei, oder sitzt du dort?
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-8.en: Does the seat stay free, or will you sit there?
dialogue:a1-invitation-choice-8.tr: Yer boş mu kalsın, yoksa sen mi oturacaksın?

choice:a1-invitation:keep-chair.de: Der Platz bleibt frei. Ich schreibe ihren Namen.
choice:a1-invitation:keep-chair.en: The seat stays free. I will write her name.
choice:a1-invitation:keep-chair.tr: Yer boş kalsın. Onun adını yazarım.

choice:a1-invitation:share-chair.de: Ich sitze dort und sage ihren Namen.
choice:a1-invitation:share-chair.en: I will sit there and say her name.
choice:a1-invitation:share-chair.tr: Ben oraya oturur ve onun adını söylerim.

dialogue:a1-invitation-complete-0.de: Bis Freitag! Deine Tasche ist auch da.
dialogue:a1-invitation-complete-0.en: See you Friday! Your bag is there too.

dialogue:a1-invitation-complete-1.de: Lina hat sie. Geh zu ihr auf die Post.
dialogue:a1-invitation-complete-1.en: Lina has it. Go to her at the post office.

dialogue:a1-invitation-after-keep-chair-.de: Gut. Eine Karte mit ihrem Namen.
dialogue:a1-invitation-after-keep-chair-.en: Good. A card with her name.
dialogue:a1-invitation-after-keep-chair-.tr: İyi. Üzerinde adı yazan bir kart.

dialogue:a1-invitation-after-keep-chair-.de: So wartet ihr Platz auf sie.
dialogue:a1-invitation-after-keep-chair-.en: That way her seat waits for her.

dialogue:a1-invitation-after-share-chair.de: Frau Berg. Jetzt ist ihr Name wieder hier.
dialogue:a1-invitation-after-share-chair.en: Frau Berg. Now her name is here again.
dialogue:a1-invitation-after-share-chair.tr: Berg Hanım. Şimdi adı yine burada.

dialogue:a1-invitation-after-share-chair.de: Du isst für zwei. Das gefällt mir!
dialogue:a1-invitation-after-share-chair.en: You eat for two. I like that!
dialogue:a1-invitation-after-share-chair.tr: İki kişilik yiyorsun. Bu hoşuma gitti!

dialogue:a1-invitation-topic-guests-0.de: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil und Greta.
dialogue:a1-invitation-topic-guests-0.en: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil and Greta.
dialogue:a1-invitation-topic-guests-0.tr: Otto, Marta, Lina, Emil ve Greta.

dialogue:a1-invitation-topic-guests-1.de: Und du. Das macht zwölf mit ihrem Platz.
dialogue:a1-invitation-topic-guests-1.en: And you. That makes twelve with her seat.
dialogue:a1-invitation-topic-guests-1.tr: Bir de sen. Onun yeriyle birlikte on iki ediyor.

dialogue:a1-invitation-topic-bring-0.tr: Ekmek. Ya da meyve. Ya da ikisi.

dialogue:a1-invitation-topic-bring-1.de: Nur keinen Tee. Ich habe schon Tee.
dialogue:a1-invitation-topic-bring-1.en: Just no tea. I already have tea.
dialogue:a1-invitation-topic-bring-1.tr: Yalnız çay getirme. Çayım zaten var.

evidence:a1-invitation:lindenhafen-marke.de: Der Tisch für Freitag. Ein Platz ist frei.
evidence:a1-invitation:lindenhafen-marke.en: The table for Friday. One seat is free.

gate-prompt:a1-lost-found.en: Tell Lina your bag is blue.

objective:a1-lost-found:0.en: Meet Lina at the post counter

objective:a1-lost-found:2.en: Tell Lina your bag is blue.

objective:a1-lost-found:3.en: Decide what happens to the black glove
objective:a1-lost-found:3.tr: Siyah eldivene ne olacağına karar ver

dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-0.de: Da bist du! Ich schreibe alles auf.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-0.en: There you are! I write everything down.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-1.de: Nummer eins: Tasche. Nummer zwei: Handschuh.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-1.en: Number one: bag. Number two: glove.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-1.tr: Bir numara: çanta. İki numara: eldiven.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-2.en: My bike is running again. Thanks!

dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-3.de: Mein Fahrrad fährt wieder. Emil schreibt es auf.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-3.en: My bike is running again. Emil is writing it down.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-3.tr: Bisikletim yine çalışıyor. Emil bunu yazıyor.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-4.de: Aus dem Zug kam eine Tasche. Sie liegt hier.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-4.en: A bag came off the train. It is lying here.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-4.tr: Trenden bir çanta geldi. Burada duruyor.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-5.de: Auf dem Tisch liegen elf Taschen.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-5.en: Eleven bags are lying on the table.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-5.tr: Masanın üstünde on bir çanta var.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-6.de: Fünf sind grün. Zwei sind alt. Eine ist groß.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-6.en: Five are green. Two are old. One is big.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-intro-6.tr: Beşi yeşil. İkisi eski. Biri büyük.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-gate-0.de: Bei mir bekommt jeder nur seine Tasche.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-gate-0.en: With me everyone only gets their own bag.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-gate-0.tr: Bende herkes yalnızca kendi çantasını alır.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-0.de: Blau und klein? Hier ist sie!
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-0.en: Blue and small? Here it is!
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-0.tr: Mavi ve küçük mü? İşte burada!

dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-1.de: Tasche gefunden. Eins von zwei. Ich schreibe es auf.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-1.en: Bag found. One of two. I am writing it down.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-2.de: Und das hier: ein schwarzer Handschuh.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-2.en: And this here: a black glove.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-2.tr: Bir de şu: siyah bir eldiven.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-3.de: Er lag auf der Bank bei Gleis sieben.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-3.en: It was lying on the bench at platform seven.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-4.de: Der Handschuh ist alt, aber die Tinte ist neu.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-4.en: The glove is old, but the ink is new.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-5.de: Am Handschuh ist ein Schild. Der Name ist weg.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-5.en: There is a tag on the glove. The name is gone.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-5.tr: Eldivenin üzerinde bir etiket var. İsim silinmiş.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-6.de: Nimmst du den Handschuh mit, oder bleibt er hier?
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-6.en: Will you take the glove, or does it stay here?
dialogue:a1-lost-found-choice-6.tr: Eldiveni yanına alıyor musun, yoksa burada mı kalsın?

choice:a1-lost-found:take-glove.en: I will take the glove with me.

choice:a1-lost-found:leave-glove.de: Er bleibt hier. Er gehört nicht mir.
choice:a1-lost-found:leave-glove.en: It stays here. It does not belong to me.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-complete-0.de: Deine blaue Tasche ist wieder bei dir.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-complete-0.en: Your blue bag is with you again.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-complete-1.de: Warte kurz. Ich suche noch deine Post.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-complete-1.en: Wait a moment. I am still looking for your post.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-complete-1.tr: Bir dakika bekle. Postana hâlâ bakıyorum.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-after-take-glove-.en: Good. I will write: glove, taken.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-after-take-glove-.de: Wem er gehört? Ich weiß es nicht.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-after-take-glove-.en: Whose it is? I do not know.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-after-leave-glove.de: Gut. Ich lege ihn oben auf den Tisch.
dialogue:a1-lost-found-after-leave-glove.en: Good. I will put it on top of the table.
Then everyone sees it at once.

dialogue:a1-lost-found-topic-bag-0.en: In the train. On the bench.

topic:a1-lost-found:glove.en: What does the glove look like?

dialogue:a1-lost-found-topic-glove-1.en: There is ink on the hand.

evidence:a1-lost-found:lindenhafen-parce.de: Der Tisch: elf Taschen und ein schwarzer Handschuh.
evidence:a1-lost-found:lindenhafen-parce.en: The table: eleven bags and a black glove.
evidence:a1-lost-found:lindenhafen-parce.tr: Masa: on bir çanta ve siyah bir eldiven.

gate-prompt:a1-lost-parcel.en: Ask Lina for the address on your parcel.

objective:a1-lost-parcel:1.en: Look at the parcel and at Gartenstraße 7

objective:a1-lost-parcel:2.en: Ask Lina for the address on your parcel.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-0.de: Da bist du ja! Ich habe ein Paket für dich.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-0.en: There you are! I have a parcel for you.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-0.tr: İşte buradasın! Senin için bir paketim var.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-1.de: Für {name}. Absender: E. Wie auf deiner Fahrkarte.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-1.en: For {name}. Sender: E. Like on your ticket.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-1.tr: {name} için. Gönderen: E. Biletinde olduğu gibi.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-2.de: Sieh deine Lampe! Am Paket ist sie sehr hell.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-2.en: Look at your lamp! By the parcel it is very bright.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-2.tr: Lambana bak! Paketin yanında çok parlak.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-3.de: Voss hat deine Lampe gebracht. Mit drei Formularen.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-3.en: Voss brought your lamp. With three forms.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-3.tr: Lambanı Voss getirdi. Üç formla birlikte.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-4.de: Deine Hände sind schwarz. Die Tinte ist auch hier.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-4.en: Your hands are black. The same ink is here too.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-4.tr: Ellerin simsiyah. Mürekkep burada da var.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-5.de: Aber die Adresse… Sieh! Die Tinte geht weg.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-5.en: But the address… Look! The ink is fading.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-6.de: Ich lese sie. Und sie ist wieder weg.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-6.en: I read it. And it is gone again.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-7.de: Das gibt es nicht. Jeder Brief kommt an. Jeder!
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-7.en: This cannot happen. Every letter arrives. Every one!
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-intro-7.tr: Bu olamaz. Her mektup yerine ulaşır. Her biri!

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-0.de: Hier ist die Adresse. Ich sehe nur ein W.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-0.en: Here is the address. I can only see a W.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-0.tr: İşte adres. Yalnızca bir W görüyorum.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-1.de: Moment. Ich lese sie wieder. Langsam.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-1.en: Hold on. I will read it again. Slowly.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-1.tr: Dur bir dakika. Yine okuyacağım. Yavaşça.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-1:variant:0.de: Warte. Ich lese sie wieder. Langsam.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-gate-1:variant:0.en: Wait. I will read it again. Slowly.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-0.de: Die Adresse? W… A… L… D…
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-0.en: The address? W… A… L… D…
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-0.tr: Adres mi? W... A... L... D...

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-1.de: Du hast gefragt. Und jetzt bleibt die Tinte!
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-1.en: You asked out loud. And now the ink is holding!
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-1.tr: Yüksek sesle sordun. Ve şimdi mürekkep duruyor!

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-3.de: W wie Waldruh. Wie auf Ottos Plan!
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-3.en: W for Waldruh. Like on Otto’s timetable!
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-3.tr: W, Waldruh'daki gibi. Otto'nun tarifesindeki gibi!

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-4.de: Im Paket ist ein Brief. Er ist sehr kurz.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-4.en: There is a letter in the parcel. It is very short.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-4.tr: Paketin içinde bir mektup var. Çok kısa.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-5.de: „Ich bin Elise. Ich warte in Waldruh.“
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-5.en: “I am Elise. I am waiting in Waldruh.”

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-7.de: Und hier ist noch ein Brief. Für Frau… Frau…
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-7.en: And here is another letter. For Frau… Frau…
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-7.tr: Bir mektup daha var burada. Bayan... Bayan...

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-8.de: Fritz sagt ihren Namen jeden Freitag. Frau Berg!
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-8.en: Fritz says her name every Friday. Frau Berg!
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-8.tr: Fritz onun adını her cuma söylüyor. Berg Hanım!

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-9.en: Frau Berg. Garden Street seven. Yes.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-10.de: Ich war heute dort. Jetzt geht auch die Sieben weg.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-10.en: I was there today. Now even the seven on her plate is fading.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-10.tr: Bugün oradaydım. Şimdi yedi de siliniyor.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-11.de: Die Leute in der Straße sagen: Wer wohnt da?
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-11.en: The people on her street say: who lives there?
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-11.tr: Sokaktaki insanlar diyor ki: orada kim oturuyor?

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-12.de: Schicke ich Voss die Adresse, oder bleibt der Brief bei dir?
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-12.en: Do I send Voss the address, or does the letter stay with you?
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-choice-12.tr: Adresi Voss'a göndereyim mi, yoksa mektup sende mi kalsın?

choice:a1-lost-parcel:report.de: Voss bekommt die Adresse. Für sein Buch.
choice:a1-lost-parcel:report.en: Voss gets the address. For his ledger.

choice:a1-lost-parcel:protect.de: Der Brief bleibt bei mir. Nur bei mir.
choice:a1-lost-parcel:protect.en: The letter stays with me. Only with me.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-after-report-0.de: Gut. Ich bringe Voss die Adresse. Heute noch.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-after-report-0.en: All right. I will take Voss the address. Today.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-after-report-1.de: Dann steht Waldruh bei ihm im Buch. Schwarz auf weiß.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-after-report-1.en: Then Waldruh is in his ledger. In black and white.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-after-report-1.tr: O zaman Waldruh onun defterine yazılır. Kara kalemle, apaçık.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-after-protect-0.de: Gut. Dein Brief, deine Post. Voss bekommt nichts.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-after-protect-0.en: Fine. Your letter, your post. Voss gets nothing.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-after-protect-0.tr: Peki. Senin mektubun, senin postan. Voss hiçbir şey almaz.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-after-protect-1.de: Ich sage nichts. Nur meinem Fahrrad. Das spricht nicht.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-after-protect-1.en: I will not say a word. Only to my bike. It does not talk.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-after-protect-1.tr: Tek kelime etmem. Yalnızca bisikletime. O konuşmaz.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-3.de: Ihr Name steht noch bei Fritz. Er bleibt.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-3.en: Her name is still written down at Fritz’s. It is staying.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-3.tr: Onun adı hâlâ Fritz'in defterinde yazıyor. Orada kalıyor.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-0.de: Geh zu Otto. Heute Abend wartet ein Zug.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-0.en: Go to Otto. A train is waiting this evening.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-0.tr: Otto'ya git. Bu akşam bir tren bekliyor.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-2.de: Im Brief steht noch ein Satz. Sehr klein:
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-2.en: There is one more sentence in the letter. Very small:
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-2.tr: Mektupta bir cümle daha var. Çok küçük:

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-1.de: Bevor du uns wieder auslöschst, komm.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-complete-1.en: Before you erase us again, come.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-inside-0.de: Ein Brief, glaube ich. Ich öffne keine Post. Nie!
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-inside-0.en: A letter, I think. I never open post. Never!
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-inside-0.tr: Sanırım bir mektup. Ben posta açmam. Asla!

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-inside-1.de: Aber es ist schwer. Für einen Brief zu schwer.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-inside-1.tr: Ama ağır. Bir mektup için fazla ağır.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-who-e-0.de: Ich weiß es nicht. Noch nicht.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-who-e-0.en: I do not know. Not yet.

dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-who-e-1.de: Aber E. schreibt immer mit schwarzer Tinte.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-who-e-1.en: But E. always writes in black ink.
dialogue:a1-lost-parcel-topic-who-e-1.tr: Ama E. hep siyah mürekkeple yazar.

evidence:a1-lost-parcel:lindenhafen-parc.de: Paket für {name}. Absender: E. Adresse: W…
evidence:a1-lost-parcel:lindenhafen-parc.en: Parcel for {name}. Sender: E. Address: W…
evidence:a1-lost-parcel:lindenhafen-parc.tr: {name} için paket. Gönderen: E. Adres: W...

evidence:a1-lost-parcel:lindenhafen-berg.de: Gartenstraße 7. Kein Name. Die Nummer geht weg.
evidence:a1-lost-parcel:lindenhafen-berg.en: Garden Street 7. No name. The number is fading.

objective:a1-departure:3.en: Choose a single or a return ticket
objective:a1-departure:3.tr: Gidiş ya da gidiş-dönüş bileti seç

dialogue:a1-departure-intro-1.de: Ein Zug steht an Gleis sieben.
dialogue:a1-departure-intro-1.en: A train is standing at platform seven.

dialogue:a1-departure-intro-2.de: Zwölf Jahre kein Zug. Und jetzt steht einer hier.
dialogue:a1-departure-intro-2.en: Twelve years without a train. And now one is standing here.
dialogue:a1-departure-intro-2.tr: On iki yıldır tren yoktu. Ve şimdi burada bir tane duruyor.

dialogue:a1-departure-intro-3.de: Die Laterne ist an. Wie jeden Morgen.
dialogue:a1-departure-intro-3.en: The lantern is on. Like every morning.
dialogue:a1-departure-intro-3.tr: Fener yanıyor. Her sabah olduğu gibi.

dialogue:a1-departure-intro-4.de: Die Laterne ist aus. Aber der Zug ist da.
dialogue:a1-departure-intro-4.en: The lantern is off. But the train is here.

dialogue:a1-departure-intro-5.de: Du hast meinen Schlüssel noch. Gut.
dialogue:a1-departure-intro-5.en: You still have my key. Good.

dialogue:a1-departure-intro-6.de: Der Zug steht nicht im Plan, Otto.
dialogue:a1-departure-intro-6.en: The train is not in the plan, Otto.

dialogue:a1-departure-intro-7.de: Ich weiß. Er ist zu pünktlich. Ich glaube ihm nicht.
dialogue:a1-departure-intro-7.en: I know. It is too punctual. I do not believe in it.

dialogue:a1-departure-gate-0.de: Ich verkaufe Fahrkarten. Das ist meine Arbeit.
dialogue:a1-departure-gate-0.en: I sell tickets. That is my job.
dialogue:a1-departure-gate-0.tr: Ben bilet satarım. Benim işim bu.

dialogue:a1-departure-gate-1.en: Where would you like to go?

dialogue:a1-departure-choice-0.de: Das Wort war weg. Jetzt ist es wieder da.
dialogue:a1-departure-choice-0.en: The word was gone. Now it is back.

dialogue:a1-departure-choice-1.de: Ich schreibe es auf das Schild. Laut: Waldruh.
dialogue:a1-departure-choice-1.en: I write it on the sign. Aloud: Waldruh.

dialogue:a1-departure-choice-2.de: Gleis sieben, achtzehn Uhr, nach Waldruh.
dialogue:a1-departure-choice-2.en: Platform seven, six o’clock, to Waldruh.

dialogue:a1-departure-choice-3.de: Das steht nicht im Plan. Ich sehe nichts.
dialogue:a1-departure-choice-3.en: That is not in the plan. I see nothing.
dialogue:a1-departure-choice-3.tr: Bu tarifede yok. Hiçbir şey görmüyorum.

dialogue:a1-departure-choice-4.de: Ich schreibe auch nichts auf. Gute Reise.
dialogue:a1-departure-choice-4.en: I am not writing anything down either. Safe journey.
dialogue:a1-departure-choice-4.tr: Ben de hiçbir şey yazmıyorum. İyi yolculuklar.

dialogue:a1-departure-choice-5.de: Das ist meine erste Fahrkarte seit zwölf Jahren.
dialogue:a1-departure-choice-5.en: This is my first ticket in twelve years.
dialogue:a1-departure-choice-5.tr: On iki yıldır ilk biletim bu.

dialogue:a1-departure-complete-0.de: Einsteigen, bitte! Es ist achtzehn Uhr.
dialogue:a1-departure-complete-0.en: All aboard, please! It is six o’clock.

dialogue:a1-departure-complete-1.de: Der Zug fährt. Elise wartet in Waldruh.
dialogue:a1-departure-complete-1.en: The train is leaving. Elise is waiting in Waldruh.

dialogue:a1-departure-after-single-0.de: Einfach nach Waldruh. Zehn Euro, bitte.
dialogue:a1-departure-after-single-0.en: Single to Waldruh. Ten euros, please.

dialogue:a1-departure-after-return-0.de: Hin und zurück. Achtzehn Euro, bitte.

dialogue:a1-departure-after-return-1.de: Dann sehen wir uns wieder. Pünktlich!
dialogue:a1-departure-after-return-1.en: Then we will see each other again. Punctually!
dialogue:a1-departure-after-return-1.tr: O zaman yine görüşürüz. Tam zamanında!

dialogue:a1-departure-topic-time-0.de: Um achtzehn Uhr. Auf die Minute.
dialogue:a1-departure-topic-time-0.en: At six o’clock. To the minute.

dialogue:a1-departure-topic-time-1.de: Eine Minute früher? Dann fährt er ohne mich.
dialogue:a1-departure-topic-time-1.en: A minute earlier? Then he goes without me.
dialogue:a1-departure-topic-time-1.tr: Bir dakika erken mi? O zaman bensiz kalkar.

topic:a1-departure:price.en: How much does the ticket cost?

dialogue:a1-departure-topic-price-0.de: Einfach zehn Euro. Hin und zurück achtzehn.
dialogue:a1-departure-topic-price-0.tr: Gidiş on euro. Gidiş-dönüş on sekiz.

evidence:a1-departure:lindenhafen-notice.de: Das Schild: Gleis eins bis sechs. Und Gleis sieben.
evidence:a1-departure:lindenhafen-notice.en: The sign: platforms one to six. And platform seven.
evidence:a1-departure:lindenhafen-notice.tr: Tabela: bir ile altıncı perona kadar. Bir de yedinci peron.

gate-prompt:a2-apartment.en: Ask Inspector Voss politely whether he could please repair it.
gate-prompt:a2-apartment.tr: Müfettiş Voss'a kibarca, onu tamir edip edemeyeceğini sor.

objective:a2-apartment:0.en: Find out why Inspector Voss is inspecting the inn
objective:a2-apartment:0.tr: Müfettiş Voss'un hanı neden denetlediğini öğren

objective:a2-apartment:2.en: Ask Inspector Voss politely whether he could please repair it.
objective:a2-apartment:2.tr: Müfettiş Voss'a kibarca, onu tamir edip edemeyeceğini sor.

objective:a2-apartment:3.en: Decide whether the door stays open
objective:a2-apartment:3.tr: Kapının açık kalıp kalmayacağına karar ver

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-0.de: Schnell, {name}, komm rein! Ich halte die Tür. Heute führt sie nach Waldruh.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-0.en: Quick, {name}, come in! I’m holding the door. Today it leads to Waldruh.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-0.tr: Çabuk, {name}, içeri gel! Kapıyı tutuyorum. Bugün Waldruh’a açılıyor.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-1.de: Vor fünf Minuten führte sie noch in meine Küche. Der Kaffee steht auf der anderen Seite.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-1.en: Five minutes ago it led into my kitchen. The coffee is still on the other side.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-1.tr: Beş dakika önce mutfağıma açılıyordu. Kahve hâlâ öbür tarafta.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-2.de: Café und Gasthaus teilen sich diese Tür. Wenn sie klemmt, komme ich an keines von beiden heran.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-2.en: The café and inn share this door. When it sticks, I can’t get into either.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-2.tr: Kafe ile han bu kapıyı paylaşıyor. Sıkışınca ikisine de giremiyorum.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-3.de: Guten Tag. Ich prüfe dieses Gebäude. Halten Sie bitte den Türrahmen fest.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-3.en: Good afternoon. I am inspecting this building. Please hold the doorframe steady.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-3.tr: İyi günler. Bu binayı denetliyorum. Lütfen kapının kasasını sabit tutun.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-4.de: Danke für die Adresse aus Lindenhafen. Sie hat mich direkt hierher geführt.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-4.tr: Lindenhafen'den gelen adres için teşekkür ederim. Beni doğrudan buraya getirdi.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-5.de: Er kam durch meine Küche. Ohne zu klopfen. Bei einem Inspektor hätte ich mehr Papier erwartet.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-5.en: He came through my kitchen. Without knocking. I expected more paperwork from an inspector.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-5.tr: Mutfağımdan girdi. Kapıyı çalmadan. Bir müfettişten daha çok evrak beklerdim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6.de: In dieser Akte steht: Waldruh ist freiwillig verschwunden. Ein seltsamer Satz für ein Dorf voller Menschen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6.en: This file says Waldruh vanished voluntarily. A strange sentence for a village full of people.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6.tr: Bu dosyada Waldruh’un kendi isteğiyle kaybolduğu yazıyor. İnsanlarla dolu bir köy için tuhaf bir cümle.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6:variant:0.de: Laut meiner Akte wollte Waldruh verschwinden. Die Menschen hier sehen das offenbar anders.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6:variant:0.en: My file says Waldruh wanted to vanish. The people here seem to disagree.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-6:variant:0.tr: Dosyama göre Waldruh kaybolmak istemiş. Buradaki insanlar belli ki farklı düşünüyor.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-7.de: Die Menschen wollen frühstücken. Für ein verschwundenes Dorf haben wir erstaunlich gute Kartoffeln.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-7.en: The people want breakfast. For a vanished village, we have remarkably good potatoes.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-7.tr: İnsanlar kahvaltı etmek istiyor. Kaybolmuş bir köy için patateslerimiz şaşırtıcı derecede iyi.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-8.de: Der Kühlschrank hat eine Nummer im Register. Diese Tür nicht. Deshalb darf ich den Rahmen nicht verändern.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-8.en: The refrigerator has a register number. This door does not. That means I cannot alter its frame.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-8.tr: Buzdolabının sicilde bir numarası var. Bu kapının yok. Bu yüzden kasasında değişiklik yapamam.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-9.de: Dann bleibt sie halb offen. Heute Morgen hat mein Ärmel in Lindenhafen festgesteckt. Ich war schon hier.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-9.en: Then it stays half open. This morning my sleeve got stuck in Lindenhafen. I was already here.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-9.tr: O zaman yarı açık kalır. Bu sabah kolum Lindenhafen’de takıldı. Ben çoktan buradaydım.

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-10.de: Ein Antrag des Mieters erlaubt die Reparatur. Wer wohnt hinter dieser Tür, in Zimmer 7?
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-10.en: A request from the tenant authorizes the repair. Who lives behind this door, in Room 7?
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-10.tr: Kiracının başvurusu onarıma izin verir. Bu kapının arkasında, 7 numaralı odada kim kalıyor?

dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-11.de: Am Brett hängt ein Mietvertrag. Dein Name steht darauf, {name}. Ich habe dir noch gar kein Zimmer angeboten.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-11.en: There’s a lease on the board. It has your name, {name}. I haven’t even offered you a room.
dialogue:a2-apartment-intro-11.tr: Panoda bir kira sözleşmesi var. Üzerinde senin adın yazıyor, {name}. Sana daha oda bile teklif etmedim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-request-0.de: Der Vertrag nennt Sie als Mieter, {name}. Die Reparatur können also Sie beantragen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-0.en: The lease names you as the tenant, {name}. You can request the repair.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-0.tr: Sözleşmede kiracı olarak siz görünüyorsunuz, {name}. Onarım için siz başvurabilirsiniz.

dialogue:a2-apartment-request-1.de: Seit drei Monaten. Dabei bist du erst heute angekommen. Deinen Zimmerschlüssel habe ich noch nie gesehen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-1.en: For three months. Yet you only arrived today. I’ve never seen your room key before.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-1.tr: Üç aydır. Oysa daha bugün geldin. Oda anahtarını daha önce hiç görmedim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-request-2.de: Das Schloss klemmt. Mein Werkzeug liegt bereit. Mit Ihrer Bitte kann ich anfangen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-2.en: The lock is stuck. My tools are ready. If you request the repair, I can begin.
dialogue:a2-apartment-request-2.tr: Kilit sıkışmış. Aletlerim hazır. Onarım talebinizle işe başlayabilirim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-react-0.de: Antrag angenommen. Erst der Stempel, dann die Schraube. Jetzt hält der Rahmen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-0.en: Request accepted. First the stamp, then the screw. The frame is holding now.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-0.tr: Başvuru kabul edildi. Önce mühür, sonra vida. Kasa artık sağlam duruyor.

dialogue:a2-apartment-react-1.de: Sie geht auf! Mein Kaffee steht noch da. Niemand hat ihn angerührt. Eine Reise war noch nie so kurz.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-1.en: It opens! My coffee is still there. Nobody touched it. I’ve never had such a short journey.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-1.tr: Açılıyor! Kahvem hâlâ orada. Kimse dokunmamış. Hiç bu kadar kısa bir yolculuk yapmamıştım.

dialogue:a2-apartment-react-2.de: Die Miete ist für ein Jahr bezahlt. Von Elise. Drei Monate vor Ihrer Ankunft.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-2.en: The rent is paid for a year. By Elise. Three months before your arrival.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-2.tr: Bir yıllık kira ödenmiş. Elise tarafından. Gelişinizden üç ay önce.

dialogue:a2-apartment-react-3.de: Entschuldigen Sie. Ich muss das Datum vergleichen. Mein Register beginnt erst mit Ihrer Fahrkarte.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-3.en: Excuse me. I need to compare the dates. My register begins with your ticket.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-3.tr: Affedersiniz. Tarihleri karşılaştırmalıyım. Sicilim sizin biletinizle başlıyor.

dialogue:a2-apartment-react-4.de: Er hält den Vertrag verkehrt herum. Das passiert ihm sonst nur bei meinen Speisekarten.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-4.en: He’s holding the lease upside down. Usually he only does that with my menus.
dialogue:a2-apartment-react-4.tr: Sözleşmeyi ters tutuyor. Bunu genelde sadece benim menülerime yapar.

dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-0.de: Durch die offene Tür kann jeder reisen. Lassen wir sie offen, oder fragen wir die Nachbarn zuerst?
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-0.en: An open door lets anyone travel through. Do we leave it open, or ask the neighbours first?
dialogue:a2-apartment-choice-0.tr: Kapı açıkken herkes geçebilir. Açık mı bırakalım, yoksa önce komşulara mı soralım?

choice:a2-apartment:restore.de: Wir lassen sie offen. Lindenhafen soll Waldruh sehen.

choice:a2-apartment:consult.de: Wir fragen zuerst die Nachbarn hier.

dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-0.de: Fritz will hier wieder einen Tisch für alle decken. Aber er nennt keinen Tag.
dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-0.en: Fritz wants to set a table for everyone here again. But he won’t name a day.
dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-0.tr: Fritz burada yeniden herkes için sofra kurmak istiyor. Ama bir gün söylemiyor.

dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-1.de: Wenn jemand nach dem Termin fragt, rührt er die Suppe. Auch wenn der Topf leer ist.
dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-1.en: Whenever anyone asks for a date, he stirs the soup. Even when the pot is empty.
dialogue:a2-apartment-complete-1.tr: Biri tarih sorunca çorbayı karıştırıyor. Tencere boşken bile.

dialogue:a2-apartment-restore-0.de: Ich stelle einen Stuhl in die Tür. Wer heute nach Waldruh will, findet einen Weg.
dialogue:a2-apartment-restore-0.en: I’ll wedge a chair in the doorway. Anyone coming to Waldruh today will find a way in.
dialogue:a2-apartment-restore-0.tr: Kapının arasına bir sandalye koyacağım. Bugün Waldruh’a gelmek isteyenler içeri girebilecek.

dialogue:a2-apartment-restore-1.de: Post für Waldruh! Drei Briefe, alle von gestern. Ich bin durch die Küche gekommen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-restore-1.tr: Waldruh'a posta! Üç mektup, hepsi dünden. Mutfaktan geçtim.

dialogue:a2-apartment-consult-0.de: Ich hänge einen Zettel auf: Erst klopfen. Niemand soll die Tür vor seinem Haus plötzlich offen finden.
dialogue:a2-apartment-consult-0.en: I’ll put up a note: knock first. Nobody should find a door outside their home opened without warning.
dialogue:a2-apartment-consult-0.tr: Bir not asacağım: Önce kapıyı çalın. Kimse evinin önündeki kapıyı habersizce açık bulmasın.

dialogue:a2-apartment-consult-1.de: Ich habe Klopfen gehört. Gibt es eine Versammlung? Ich habe Suppe dabei.
dialogue:a2-apartment-consult-1.tr: Kapı çalındığını duydum. Toplantı mı var? Yanımda çorba getirdim.

topic:a2-apartment:one-door.de: Warum haben dein Café und das Gasthaus dieselbe Tür?
topic:a2-apartment:one-door.tr: Kafenle han neden aynı kapıyı paylaşıyor?

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-0.de: Meine Oma sagt, früher war das ein Haus. Die Strecke lief mitten durch den Flur.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-0.tr: Ninem eskiden burasının tek bir ev olduğunu söylüyor. Hat tam koridorun ortasından geçiyormuş.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-1.de: Dann war die Strecke weg. Und das Haus stand auf einmal in zwei Städten.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-1.tr: Sonra hat ortadan kalktı. Ve ev birdenbire iki şehirde birden duruyordu.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-2.de: Die Tür ist geblieben. Türen sind treuer als Akten.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-one-door-2.tr: Kapı kaldı. Kapılar dosyalardan daha vefalıdır.

topic:a2-apartment:voss-stay.de: Wie lange bleiben Sie in Waldruh, Herr Voss?
topic:a2-apartment:voss-stay.tr: Waldruh'da ne kadar kalacaksınız, Voss Bey?

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-0.de: Bis die Akte und das Dorf dasselbe sagen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-0.tr: Dosya ile köy aynı şeyi söyleyene kadar.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-1.de: Bis dahin bleibt die Akte gültig. Sonst müsste ich jede Entscheidung meines Amts neu prüfen.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-1.en: Until then, the file stands. Otherwise I would have to reconsider every decision my office has made.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-1.tr: O zamana kadar dosya geçerli. Aksi hâlde dairemin verdiği her kararı yeniden incelemem gerekir.

dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-2.de: Ich mache ihm ein Bett. Er hat schon gefragt, ob das Kissen registriert ist.
dialogue:a2-apartment-topic-voss-stay-2.tr: Ona bir yatak hazırlayacağım. Yastığın kayıtlı olup olmadığını şimdiden sordu.

evidence:a2-apartment:waldruh-housing-bo.de: Mietvertrag für Zimmer 7. Mieter: {name}. Die Miete für ein Jahr hat Elise im Voraus bezahlt. Zwei Adressen: Gasthaus Waldruh und Martas Café in Lindenhafen. Eine Tür. Gültig seit drei Monaten. Am Papier hängt ein schwerer Schlüssel mit einer kleinen Laterne.
evidence:a2-apartment:waldruh-housing-bo.tr: 7 numaralı oda için kira sözleşmesi. Kiracı: {name}. Bir yıllık kirayı Elise peşin ödemiş. İki adres: Waldruh Hanı ve Marta'nın Lindenhafen'deki kafesi. Tek bir kapı. Üç aydır geçerli. Kâğıtta, küçük bir fenerle süslü ağır bir anahtar asılı.

gate-prompt:a2-evening-plans.en: Ask Fritz whether he has time tomorrow.
gate-prompt:a2-evening-plans.tr: Fritz'e yarın vakti olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a2-evening-plans:0.en: Listen to the argument about Fritz’s festival

objective:a2-evening-plans:1.en: Read the Circle’s calendar at the herb garden

objective:a2-evening-plans:2.en: Ask Fritz whether he has time tomorrow.
objective:a2-evening-plans:2.tr: Fritz'e yarın vakti olup olmadığını sor.

objective:a2-evening-plans:3.en: Decide whether to send the signal or hear the Circle first
objective:a2-evening-plans:3.tr: Önce sinyali mi göndereceğinize, yoksa topluluğu mu dinleyeceğinize karar ver

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-0.de: Heute Abend senden wir das Signal. Wenn Lindenhafen unser Licht sieht, wissen sie, dass Waldruh noch da ist.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-0.en: Tonight we send the signal. When Lindenhafen sees our light, they’ll know Waldruh is still here.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-0.tr: Bu akşam sinyali gönderiyoruz. Lindenhafen ışığımızı görünce Waldruh’un hâlâ burada olduğunu anlayacak.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-1.de: Und was sagen wir denen, die hier wohnen? Sie erfahren wieder zuletzt, was mit ihrem Dorf passiert.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-1.en: And what do we tell the people living here? Once again, they’re last to hear what happens to their village.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-1.tr: Peki burada yaşayanlara ne diyeceğiz? Köylerine ne olduğunu yine en son onlar öğrenecek.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-2.de: Ah, {name}. Nimm einen Teller. Solange alle essen, streitet niemand. Meistens.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-2.en: Ah, {name}. Take a bowl. While everyone’s eating, nobody argues. Usually.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-2.tr: Ah, {name}. Bir kâse al. Herkes yemek yerken kimse tartışmaz. Genelde.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-3.de: Fritz hat schon die Teller gezählt. Jetzt fehlen ihm nur noch Gäste. Und ein Termin.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-3.en: Fritz has counted the bowls. All he needs now are guests. And a date.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-3.tr: Fritz kâseleri saydı bile. Şimdi sadece misafirler eksik. Bir de tarih.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-4.de: Ich bin Greta. Hier wächst unser Essen. Der Farn überwacht alles. Bitte Abstand halten, er niest.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-4.en: I’m Greta. We grow our food here. The fern supervises everything. Keep your distance; he sneezes.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-4.tr: Ben Greta. Yiyeceklerimizi burada yetiştiriyoruz. Eğreltiotu her şeyi denetliyor. Lütfen fazla yaklaşma, hapşırıyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-5.de: Wir gehören zum Kreis der Ungeschriebenen. Manche von uns stehen in keiner Akte. Alle sitzen an Fritz’ Tisch.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-5.en: We belong to the Unwritten Circle. Some of us appear in no file. All of us sit at Fritz’s table.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-5.tr: Yazılmamışlar Topluluğu’ndanız. Bazılarımız hiçbir dosyada yer almıyor. Hepimiz Fritz’in sofrasında oturuyoruz.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6.de: Niemand hat uns gefragt, bevor die Strecke geschlossen wurde. Im Papier steht trotzdem: freiwillig.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6.en: Nobody asked us before the route closed. The paper still says: voluntary.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6.tr: Hat kapatılmadan önce bize kimse sormadı. Buna rağmen evrakta “gönüllü” yazıyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6:varian.de: Die Strecke wurde geschlossen. Uns hat niemand gefragt. Auf dem Papier steht, wir wollten es so.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6:varian.en: The route was closed. Nobody asked us. The paper says we wanted it.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-6:varian.tr: Hat kapatıldı. Bize kimse sormadı. Evrakta bunu istediğimiz yazıyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-7.de: Wir haben an diesem Abend hier gegessen. Um sechs. Ich holte noch Brot. Danach war die Strecke weg.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-7.en: We ate here that evening. At six. I went to fetch more bread. Afterwards the route was gone.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-7.tr: O akşam burada yemek yedik. Saat altıda. Biraz daha ekmek getirmeye gittim. Sonra hat yok olmuştu.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-8.de: Seitdem deckt er jeden Abend den Tisch. Aber er lädt niemanden zu einer festen Zeit ein.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-8.en: Ever since, he sets the table every evening. But he never invites anyone for a definite time.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-8.tr: O günden beri her akşam sofra kuruyor. Ama kimseyi belli bir saate davet etmiyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-9.de: Frau Berg hat geschrieben. Ihr Haus ist weg. Ihren Namen hat sie behalten. Für sie decken wir mit.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-9.en: Frau Berg wrote to us. Her house is gone. She still has her name. We’ll set a place for her.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-9.tr: Frau Berg bize yazdı. Evi yok olmuş. Adı hâlâ var. Onun için de bir yer hazırlayacağız.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-10.de: Die Frau aus Lindenhafen, mit den Äpfeln. Ich will ihr schreiben. Ihr Name fällt mir nicht mehr ein.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-10.en: The woman from Lindenhafen, with the apples. I want to write to her. I can’t remember her name.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-10.tr: Lindenhafen’deki kadın, elmaları olan. Ona yazmak istiyorum. Adını hatırlayamıyorum.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-11.de: Unser Kalender hängt am Kräutergarten. Er ist … sehr ehrlich.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-intro-11.tr: Takvimimiz ot bahçesinde asılı. Kendisi… çok dürüsttür.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-0.de: Meine Briefe müssen heute los. Sonst erreicht die Einladung niemanden rechtzeitig.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-0.en: My letters have to leave today. Otherwise the invitations won’t reach anyone in time.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-0.tr: Mektuplarım bugün yola çıkmalı. Yoksa davetler kimseye zamanında ulaşmaz.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-1.de: Morgen können alle kommen. Fritz, du entscheidest, ob dein Tisch auf uns wartet.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-1.en: Everyone can come tomorrow. Fritz, it’s your decision whether your table will be waiting for us.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-1.tr: Yarın herkes gelebilir. Fritz, sofranın bizi bekleyip beklemeyeceğine sen karar vereceksin.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-2.de: Morgen steht noch nichts in meinem Kalender. Aber wenn ich einlade, verspreche ich, dass wir uns wiedersehen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-2.en: There’s nothing in my calendar tomorrow. But if I invite everyone, I’m promising we’ll see each other again.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-request-2.tr: Yarın takvimimde hiçbir şey yok. Ama davet edersem yeniden görüşeceğimize söz vermiş olurum.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-0.de: Morgen? Ja. Für dich habe ich Zeit. Und für die anderen auch.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-0.en: Tomorrow? Yes. I have time for you. And for everyone else too.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-0.tr: Yarın mı? Evet. Sana zamanım var. Diğerlerine de.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-1.de: Halb sieben. Nicht wieder um sechs. Ich will die Uhr hören, ohne den leeren Bahnhof zu sehen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-1.en: Half past six. Six is too much. I want to hear the clock without seeing the empty station.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-1.tr: Altı buçuk. Yine altı olmasın. Saati duyduğumda boş istasyonu görmek istemiyorum.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-2.de: Ich schreibe es auf. Morgen, halb sieben. Lina, diesmal geht die Einladung an jeden.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-2.en: I’ll write it down. Tomorrow, half past six. Lina, this time the invitation goes to everyone.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-2.tr: Yazıyorum. Yarın, altı buçuk. Lina, bu kez davet herkese gidecek.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-3.de: Wir kommen, Fritz. Du musst den Tisch nicht allein decken.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-3.en: We’ll be there, Fritz. You don’t have to set the table alone.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-3.tr: Geleceğiz, Fritz. Sofrayı tek başına kurmak zorunda değilsin.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-4.de: Gut. Aber Lindenhafen wartet auf ein Lebenszeichen. Das Licht können wir noch heute schicken.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-4.en: Good. But Lindenhafen is waiting for a sign we’re still here. We can send the light tonight.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-react-4.tr: Güzel. Ama Lindenhafen hâlâ burada olduğumuza dair bir işaret bekliyor. Işığı bu akşam gönderebiliriz.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-0.de: Senden wir heute ein Lebenszeichen, oder wartet das Signal, bis alle hier ihre Wünsche gesagt haben?
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-0.en: Do we send a sign tonight, or wait until everyone here has said what they want?
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-choice-0.tr: Bu akşam bir işaret gönderelim mi, yoksa buradaki herkes isteğini söyleyene kadar sinyali bekletelim mi?

choice:a2-evening-plans:restore.de: Wir senden heute Licht. Lindenhafen soll wissen, dass ihr noch hier seid.
choice:a2-evening-plans:restore.en: We send the light tonight. Lindenhafen should know you’re still here.
choice:a2-evening-plans:restore.tr: Bu akşam ışık gönderelim. Lindenhafen hâlâ burada olduğunuzu bilmeli.

choice:a2-evening-plans:consult.de: Wir hören zuerst den Kreis. Diesmal warten wir auf ihre Antworten.
choice:a2-evening-plans:consult.en: We hear the Circle first. This time we wait for their answers.
choice:a2-evening-plans:consult.tr: Önce topluluğu dinleyelim. Bu kez cevaplarını bekleyelim.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-0.de: Morgen, halb sieben. Ich stelle auch die kleinen Teller hin. Die Kinder sollen uns finden.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-0.en: Tomorrow, half past six. I’ll put out the little bowls too. The children should find us here.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-0.tr: Yarın, altı buçuk. Küçük kâseleri de koyacağım. Çocuklar bizi burada bulabilsin.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-1.de: Ach, und Otto sucht dich. Er hat unter dem Bahnhof einen alten Fahrplan gefunden.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-complete-1.tr: Ha, bir de Otto seni arıyor. İstasyonun altında eski bir tarife bulmuş.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-restore-0.de: Laternen an! Eins, zwei, drei … Das Licht geht über den Wald.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-restore-0.tr: Fenerler yansın! Bir, iki, üç… Işık ormanın üzerinden geçiyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-restore-1.de: Lindenhafen antwortet! Drei kurze Lichter. Marta kennt unser Zeichen noch.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-restore-1.en: Lindenhafen is answering! Three short flashes. Marta still remembers our signal.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-restore-1.tr: Lindenhafen cevap veriyor! Üç kısa ışık. Marta işaretimizi hâlâ hatırlıyor.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-0.de: Ich schreibe die Wünsche auf. Der Farn bekommt die letzte Zeile. Er hat schon genug Aufmerksamkeit.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-0.en: I’ll write down everyone’s wishes. The fern gets the last line. He’s had enough attention already.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-0.tr: Herkesin isteğini yazacağım. Eğreltiotu son satırı alacak. Zaten yeterince ilgi gördü.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-1.de: Am Waldrand kommen Leute mit Stühlen. Sie haben ihre Namen mitgebracht. Heute bleiben sie nicht draußen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-1.en: People are coming from the forest with chairs. They’ve brought their names. Today they won’t be left outside.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-consult-1.tr: Ormanın kenarından sandalyeleriyle insanlar geliyor. Adlarını da getirmişler. Bugün dışarıda kalmayacaklar.

topic:a2-evening-plans:circle.de: Wer gehört zum Kreis der Ungeschriebenen?

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-0.de: Alle, deren Namen einmal falsch oder gar nicht aufgeschrieben wurden.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-0.tr: Adı bir zamanlar yanlış yazılan ya da hiç yazılmayan herkes.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-1.de: Wir erinnern uns gegenseitig. Jeden Morgen sagen wir unsere Namen laut. Das hilft.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-circle-1.tr: Birbirimizi hatırlıyoruz. Her sabah isimlerimizi yüksek sesle söylüyoruz. İşe yarıyor.

topic:a2-evening-plans:fern.de: Warum ist dein Farn unter Beobachtung?

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fern-0.de: Er hat letzte Woche auf einen Stempel vom Messingamt geniest. Seitdem ist der Stempel grün.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fern-0.tr: Geçen hafta Pirinç Dairesi'nin bir damgasına hapşırdı. O günden beri damga yeşil.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fern-1.de: Ich beobachte ihn. Er beobachtet das Amt. Das ist fair.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fern-1.tr: Ben onu gözlüyorum. O da Daire'yi gözlüyor. Bu adil.

topic:a2-evening-plans:fritz-here.de: Warum bist du in Waldruh, Fritz?

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fritz-he.de: Meine Äpfel rollen seit einer Woche alle nach Norden. Ich bin hinterhergelaufen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fritz-he.tr: Elmalarım bir haftadır hep kuzeye yuvarlanıyor. Peşlerinden geldim.

dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fritz-he.de: Und hier gibt es Kürbisse, so groß wie Koffer. Ich bleibe ein bisschen.
dialogue:a2-evening-plans-topic-fritz-he.tr: Burada da bavul büyüklüğünde balkabakları var. Biraz kalacağım.

evidence:a2-evening-plans:waldruh-herb-g.de: Kalender des Kreises. Laternenfest: dreimal verschoben. Neuer Termin: offen. Daneben hängt die Einladung zum letzten gemeinsamen Abendessen. Alle Namen sind verblasst. Nur „18 Uhr“ ist noch lesbar. Fritz hat einen Topf daneben gezeichnet.
evidence:a2-evening-plans:waldruh-herb-g.en: The Circle’s calendar. Lantern festival: postponed three times. New date: undecided. Beside it hangs the invitation to the last shared supper. Every name has faded. Only “6 p.m.” is legible. Fritz drew a cooking pot beside it.
evidence:a2-evening-plans:waldruh-herb-g.tr: Topluluğun takvimi. Fener şenliği üç kez ertelenmiş. Yeni tarih belirsiz. Yanında son ortak akşam yemeğinin daveti asılı. Bütün adlar solmuş. Yalnızca “18.00” okunabiliyor. Fritz yanına bir tencere çizmiş.

gate-prompt:a2-rail-trip.en: Tell Otto that you missed your connection.

objective:a2-rail-trip:0.en: Try to catch the evening connection with Otto
objective:a2-rail-trip:0.tr: Otto ile akşam aktarmasına yetişmeye çalış

objective:a2-rail-trip:1.en: Read what is under the new paint on the route sign
objective:a2-rail-trip:1.tr: Hat tabelasındaki yeni boyanın altında ne yazdığını oku

objective:a2-rail-trip:2.en: Tell Otto that you missed your connection.

objective:a2-rail-trip:3.en: Decide what happens to the missing minute
objective:a2-rail-trip:3.tr: Kayıp dakikaya ne olacağına karar ver

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-0.de: Zum Bahnsteig, {name}! Hörst du das Pfeifen? Heute bekommen wir diesen Zug zu sehen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-0.en: To the platform, {name}! Hear that whistle? Today we’ll see this train for ourselves.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-0.tr: Perona, {name}! Düdüğü duyuyor musun? Bugün bu treni kendi gözlerimizle göreceğiz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-1.de: Der alte Fahrplan nennt einen Anschluss nach Nebelstadt. Abfahrt: 18:00. Die Fahrkarte sagt dasselbe.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-1.en: The old timetable lists a connection to Nebelstadt. Departure: 18:00. The ticket says the same.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-1.tr: Eski tarifede Nebelstadt’a bir aktarma treni var. Kalkış: 18.00. Bilette de aynı saat yazıyor.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-2.de: Die Bahnhofsuhr steht noch vor sechs. Er müsste warten. Die Türen sind schon geschlossen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-2.en: The station clock hasn’t reached six. It should be waiting. Its doors are already closed.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-2.tr: İstasyon saatinde daha altı olmadı. Beklemesi gerekirdi. Kapıları çoktan kapanmış.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-3.de: Ihre Fahrkarte, bitte. Diese Kontrolle kann ich nicht überspringen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-3.en: Your ticket, please. I cannot skip this inspection.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-4.de: Herr Voss, Sie sehen doch, dass er losfährt!
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-4.en: Mr Voss, you can see it’s leaving!

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-5.de: Gültig. Abfahrt 18:00. Sie sind rechtzeitig hier. Der Zug müsste ...
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-5.en: Valid. Departure: 18:00. You are here on time. The train should ...

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-6.de: Weg. Wir standen direkt vor der Tür. Er ist ohne uns gefahren.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-6.en: Gone. We were right outside the door. It left without us.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-6.tr: Gitti. Tam kapısının önündeydik. Bizi almadan gitti.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-7.de: Dein Register aus Lindenhafen hat dieselben leeren Zeilen. Heute tragen wir ein, wer hier stand.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-7.en: Your Lindenhafen register has the same blank lines. Today we’ll record who was standing here.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-7.tr: Lindenhafen sicilinde de aynı boş satırlar var. Bugün burada kimin durduğunu kaydedeceğiz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-8.de: Mein Schlüssel öffnet jede Bahnhofstür. Einen Zug hält er leider nicht an.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-8.en: My key opens every station door. Sadly, it won’t stop a train.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-8.tr: Anahtarım istasyonun bütün kapılarını açar. Ne yazık ki treni durdurmaz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-9.de: Meine Akte sagt, hier fährt kein Zug. Ich habe eben einen gesehen. Beides schreibe ich auf.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-9.en: My file says no train runs here. I just saw one. I will write down both.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-9.tr: Dosyam burada tren çalışmadığını söylüyor. Az önce bir tane gördüm. İkisini de yazacağım.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-10.de: Seit Jahren wartet hier niemand. Heute hat der Zug einen Fahrgast zurückgelassen. Das lässt sich prüfen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-10.en: Nobody has waited here for years. Today the train left a passenger behind. We can investigate that.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-10.tr: Yıllardır burada kimse beklemiyor. Bugün tren bir yolcuyu geride bıraktı. Bunu araştırabiliriz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-11.de: Am alten Schild blättert die Farbe ab. Darunter steht noch das Ziel. Die Uhrzeit fehlt.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-11.en: The paint is peeling off the old sign. The destination is underneath. The time is missing.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-intro-11.tr: Eski tabelanın boyası dökülüyor. Altında hâlâ varış yeri yazıyor. Saat eksik.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-0.de: Ich öffne den Schalter. Deine Fahrkarte bleibt hier, neben der Bahnhofsuhr.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-0.en: I’ll open the ticket window. Your ticket stays here beside the station clock.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-0.tr: Gişeyi açıyorum. Biletin burada, istasyon saatinin yanında kalacak.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-1.de: Ich bestätige, dass Sie vor der Abfahrt hier waren. Für den Bericht brauche ich Ihre Aussage.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-1.en: I confirm that you were here before departure. I need your account for the report.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-1.tr: Kalkıştan önce burada olduğunuzu doğruluyorum. Rapor için ifadenize ihtiyacım var.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-2.de: Bahnhof Waldruh, Schalter eins. Die Fahrkarte ist gültig. Warum konntest du nicht weiterfahren?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-2.en: Waldruh station, window one. The ticket is valid. Why couldn’t you continue your journey?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-request-2.tr: Waldruh istasyonu, bir numaralı gişe. Bilet geçerli. Yolculuğuna neden devam edemedin?

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-0.de: Verpasster Anschluss. Ich vergleiche deine Fahrkarte mit der Uhr. Sie hat bei der Abfahrt angehalten.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-0.en: Missed connection. I’ll compare your ticket with the clock. It stopped as the train departed.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-0.tr: Kaçırılan aktarma. Biletini saatle karşılaştırıyorum. Tren kalkarken saat durmuş.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-1.de: 17:59. Auf deiner Fahrkarte steht 18:00. Wer nach der Fahrkarte kommt, sieht nur noch den leeren Bahnsteig.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-1.en: 17:59. Your ticket says 18:00. Anyone following the ticket arrives to find an empty platform.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-1.tr: 17.59. Biletinde 18.00 yazıyor. Biletteki saate göre gelenler yalnızca boş peronu görüyor.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-2.de: Auf dem Schild steht jetzt: von innen geschlossen, mit einem Hüterschlüssel. Die frühe Abfahrt hält Zeugen fern.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-2.en: The sign now says: closed from inside, with a keeper’s key. Leaving early keeps witnesses away.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-2.tr: Tabelada artık bir koruyucu anahtarıyla içeriden kapatıldığı yazıyor. Erken kalkış, tanıkların gelmesini engelliyor.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-3.de: Von innen geschlossen. Das fehlt in meiner Akte. Auch Ihre rechtzeitige Ankunft fehlt dort.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-3.en: Closed from inside. My file omits that. It also omits your arrival on time.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-3.tr: İçeriden kapatılmış. Bu, dosyamda yok. Zamanında gelişiniz de yok.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-4.de: Dieses Pfeifen kenne ich. Es ist auf meiner Aufnahme. Abends höre ich einen Zug, den es angeblich nicht gibt.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-4.en: I know that whistle. It’s on my recording. Every evening I hear a train that supposedly doesn’t exist.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-4.tr: Bu düdüğü tanıyorum. Kaydımda da var. Her akşam var olmadığı söylenen bir treni dinliyorum.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-5.de: Ich kann die Bahnhofsuhr angleichen. Dann finden die Fahrgäste morgen ihren Anschluss.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-5.en: I can adjust the station clock. Tomorrow the passengers will be able to catch their connection.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-5.tr: İstasyon saatini ayarlayabilirim. Böylece yolcular yarın aktarma trenine yetişir.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-6.de: Aber der Fahrplan verändert sich mit ihr. Die falsche Zeit bleibt nur, solange wir sie nicht korrigieren.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-6.en: But the timetable changes with it. The false time stays visible only until we correct it.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-react-6.tr: Ama tarife de saatle birlikte değişir. Yanlış saat, ancak biz düzeltmediğimiz sürece görünür kalır.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-0.de: Gleichen wir die Uhr für die Fahrgäste an, oder lassen wir den Fehler stehen, bis weitere Zeugen kommen?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-0.en: Do we adjust the clock for passengers, or leave the error visible until more witnesses arrive?
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-choice-0.tr: Yolcular için saati ayarlayalım mı, yoksa başka tanıklar gelene kadar hatayı görünür mü bırakalım?

choice:a2-rail-trip:restore.de: Wir gleichen die Uhr an. Morgen soll niemand mehr hier zurückbleiben.
choice:a2-rail-trip:restore.en: We adjust the clock. Tomorrow nobody should be left behind here.
choice:a2-rail-trip:restore.tr: Saati ayarlayalım. Yarın kimse burada geride kalmasın.

choice:a2-rail-trip:consult.de: Wir sichern die falsche Zeit. Andere sollen den Fehler selbst sehen.
choice:a2-rail-trip:consult.en: We preserve the false time. Others should see the error for themselves.
choice:a2-rail-trip:consult.tr: Yanlış saati koruyalım. Başkaları da hatayı kendi gözleriyle görsün.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-0.de: Ein Hüterschlüssel schließt keine gewöhnliche Tür. Nimm deinen Schlüssel mit. Wir müssen wissen, was er kann.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-0.en: A keeper’s key doesn’t close an ordinary door. Bring your key. We need to know what it can do.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-0.tr: Bir koruyucu anahtarı sıradan bir kapıyı kapatmaz. Anahtarını getir. Neler yapabildiğini öğrenmeliyiz.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-1.de: Emils Werkzeuge waren eine Nacht lang weg. Danach lag ein Dankesbrief daneben. Vielleicht hängt beides zusammen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-1.en: Emil’s tools vanished for a night. Afterwards a thank-you note appeared beside them. Perhaps the two are connected.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-complete-1.tr: Emil’in aletleri bir geceliğine kaybolmuş. Sonra yanlarında bir teşekkür notu belirmiş. Belki ikisi bağlantılıdır.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-0.de: Eine Minute vor. Die Uhr läuft wieder. Die Tauben sind empört; ihr Abendplan stimmt nicht mehr.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-0.en: One minute forward. The clock is running again. The pigeons are furious; their evening schedule is ruined.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-0.tr: Bir dakika ileri. Saat yeniden çalışıyor. Güvercinler öfkeli; akşam programları bozuldu.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-1.de: Nebelstadt, 18:00. Das Ziel bleibt auf der Anzeige. Morgen warten hier Menschen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-1.en: Nebelstadt, 18:00. The destination stays on the board. Tomorrow people will be waiting here.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-restore-1.tr: Nebelstadt, 18.00. Varış yeri panoda kalıyor. Yarın burada insanlar bekleyecek.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-0.de: Ich schreibe beide Zeiten ab. Eine Kopie bleibt am Schalter. Jeder kann sie vergleichen.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-0.en: I’ll copy both times. One copy stays at the window. Anyone can compare them.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-0.tr: İki saati de yazacağım. Bir nüsha gişede kalacak. Herkes karşılaştırabilecek.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-1.de: Ich nehme die zweite Kopie. Morgen stehen hier Leute, die man nicht mehr aus dem Bericht streichen kann.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-1.en: I’ll take the second copy. Tomorrow there’ll be people here who can no longer be left out of the report.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-consult-1.tr: İkinci nüshayı ben alıyorum. Yarın burada, rapordan artık çıkarılamayacak insanlar duracak.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-0.de: Ein Zug kann pünktlich sein und trotzdem niemanden mitnehmen. Seit heute traue ich auch der Fahrkarte nicht.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-0.en: A train can be punctual and still take nobody aboard. As of today, I don’t trust the ticket either.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-0.tr: Bir tren dakik olabilir ama yine de kimseyi almayabilir. Bugünden sonra bilete de güvenmiyorum.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-1.de: Die Tauben wissen, wann der Zug kommt. Keine hat mir den Fahrplan gezeigt. Unkollegial.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-1.en: The pigeons know when the train comes. None has shown me its timetable. Very unprofessional.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-punctual-1.tr: Güvercinler trenin ne zaman geldiğini biliyor. Hiçbiri bana tarifesini göstermedi. Meslektaşlığa yakışmıyor.

topic:a2-rail-trip:voss-how.de: Wie sind Sie nach Waldruh gekommen, Herr Voss?

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-voss-how-0.de: Durch eine Küchentür. Das stand nicht im Dienstplan.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-voss-how-0.tr: Bir mutfak kapısından. Bu, görev çizelgesinde yoktu.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-voss-how-1.de: Seitdem schlafe ich schlecht. Das ist für mich ungewöhnlich.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-voss-how-1.tr: O zamandan beri kötü uyuyorum. Bu benim için alışılmadık bir durum.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-destination-.de: Nach Nebelstadt, sagt das alte Schild. Das neue sagt: nirgendwohin.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-destination-.tr: Eski tabela “Nebelstadt'a” diyor. Yenisi: hiçbir yere.

dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-destination-.de: Ich glaube dem alten. Altes Holz lügt seltener.
dialogue:a2-rail-trip-topic-destination-.tr: Ben eskisine inanırım. Eski tahta daha az yalan söyler.

evidence:a2-rail-trip:waldruh-route-sign.de: Neue Tafel: „Hier gab es nie eine Strecke.“ Unter der Farbe steht: „Anschluss nach Nebelstadt.“ Das Feld für die Abfahrtszeit ist leer. Daneben ist eine kleine Laterne ins Holz gebrannt.
evidence:a2-rail-trip:waldruh-route-sign.en: New sign: “There was never a route here.” Beneath the paint: “Connection to Nebelstadt.” The departure-time field is blank. A small lantern is burned into the wood beside it.
evidence:a2-rail-trip:waldruh-route-sign.tr: Yeni tabela: “Burada hiç hat olmadı.” Boyanın altında “Nebelstadt’a aktarma” yazıyor. Kalkış saati boş. Yanına, ahşaba küçük bir fener işlenmiş.

gate-prompt:a2-broken-clock.en: Ask Emil whether he can explain the manual to you.
gate-prompt:a2-broken-clock.tr: Emil'e kılavuzu sana açıklayıp açıklayamayacağını sor.

objective:a2-broken-clock:0.en: Find out what is wrong with the clockmill

objective:a2-broken-clock:1.en: Read the manual and the memory stone

objective:a2-broken-clock:2.en: Ask Emil whether he can explain the manual to you.
objective:a2-broken-clock:2.tr: Emil'e kılavuzu sana açıklayıp açıklayamayacağını sor.

objective:a2-broken-clock:3.en: Decide whether to stop the cycle or gather the missing names first
objective:a2-broken-clock:3.tr: Önce döngüyü mü durduracağınıza, yoksa kayıp adları mı toplayacağınıza karar ver

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-0.de: Vorsicht, {name}! Der Boden ist fest. Nur die Stunde darauf fehlt manchmal.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-0.en: Careful, {name}! The floor is solid. Sometimes it’s the hour standing on it that disappears.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-0.tr: Dikkat, {name}! Zemin sağlam. Bazen kaybolan, üzerinde duran saat dilimi oluyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-1.de: Die Mühle wiederholt jede Nacht die Stunde vor Mitternacht. Draußen wird es Morgen. Hier fängt dieselbe Stunde wieder an.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-1.en: Every night the mill repeats the hour before midnight. Outside, morning comes. Here, the same hour begins again.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-1.tr: Değirmen her gece, gece yarısından önceki saati tekrarlıyor. Dışarıda sabah oluyor. Burada aynı saat yeniden başlıyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-2.de: Nach jeder Runde fehlt ein Name am Stein. Gestern kannte ich den Menschen noch. Heute kenne ich die Lücke.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-2.en: After every cycle, a name disappears from the stone. Yesterday I knew the person. Today I know the gap.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-2.tr: Her döngüden sonra taştan bir ad siliniyor. Dün o kişiyi tanıyordum. Bugün boşluğu tanıyorum.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-3.de: Auf meiner Reparaturquittung steht morgen. Der Kaffee darauf war definitiv von gestern.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-3.en: My repair receipt is dated tomorrow. The coffee on it is definitely from yesterday.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-3.tr: Onarım fişimde yarının tarihi var. Üstündeki kahve lekesi kesinlikle dünden.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-4.de: Meine Werkzeuge waren eine Nacht lang weg. Genau da begann die Mühle, diese Stunde zu wiederholen.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-4.en: My tools vanished for a night. That was when the mill began repeating this hour.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-4.tr: Aletlerim bir geceliğine kayboldu. Değirmen tam o zaman bu saati tekrarlamaya başladı.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-5.de: Sie kamen sauber zurück. Mit einem Dankesbrief. Sogar meine schlechteste Zange war wieder schön.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-5.en: They came back clean. With a thank-you note. Even my worst pair of pliers looked lovely.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-5.tr: Tertemiz geri geldiler. Bir teşekkür notuyla. En kötü pensim bile güzelleşmişti.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-6.de: Ah, meine Lampe! Sie zittert immer, wenn die Mühle die Stunde wiederholt.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-6.tr: Ah, lambam! Değirmen saati tekrarlayınca hep titrer.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-7.de: Voss hat meine Lampe registriert. Der Name ist sicher. Hoffentlich reicht das auch für die Menschen.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-7.en: Voss registered my lamp. Its name is safe. I hope that will be enough for the people too.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-7.tr: Voss lambamı kayda geçirdi. Adı güvende. Umarım insanlar için de yeterli olur.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-8.de: Die Anleitung hängt an der Uhr. Vergleich sie mit dem Stein. Hier fehlt mehr als ein Zahnrad.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-8.en: The manual hangs from the clock. Compare it with the stone. We’re missing more than a cog here.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-intro-8.tr: Kılavuz saatin üzerinde asılı. Taşla karşılaştır. Burada bir dişliden fazlası eksik.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-request-0.de: Ich kann die Schritte erklären. Bevor wir die Uhr reparieren, müssen wir jeden Schritt verstehen.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-request-0.en: I can explain the steps. Before we repair the clock, we need to understand each one.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-request-0.tr: Adımları açıklayabilirim. Saati onarmadan önce her adımı anlamamız gerekiyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-request-1.de: Roter Hebel, blauer Anschluss. Die Zeichnung sieht einfach aus. Die Mühle hält sich nicht immer daran.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-request-1.en: Red lever, blue connection. The diagram looks simple. The mill doesn’t always follow it.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-request-1.tr: Kırmızı kol, mavi bağlantı. Çizim basit görünüyor. Değirmen ona her zaman uymuyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-request-2.de: Du hast die Anleitung gelesen. Bevor wir etwas anfassen, können wir sie zusammen durchgehen.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-request-2.en: You’ve read the manual. Before we touch anything, we can walk through it together.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-request-2.tr: Kılavuzu okudun. Bir şeye dokunmadan önce birlikte üzerinden geçebiliriz.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-0.de: Gern. Der rote Hebel hält die Mühle an. Dann wiederholt sie die Stunde nicht mehr.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-0.en: Of course. The red lever stops the mill. Then it stops repeating the hour.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-0.tr: Elbette. Kırmızı kol değirmeni durdurur. O zaman saati tekrarlamayı bırakır.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-1.de: Der blaue Anschluss verbindet sie mit dem Streckensignal. Jemand hat ihn getrennt. Kein Bruch. Ein sauberer Schnitt.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-1.en: The blue connection links it to the route signal. Someone disconnected it. No break. A clean cut.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-1.tr: Mavi bağlantı, onu hattın sinyaline bağlar. Biri bağlantıyı ayırmış. Kırılmamış. Düzgünce kesilmiş.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-2.de: Am Rand steht: „Bitte nur trennen, wenn es sein muss. Danke für das Werkzeug.“
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-2.en: The margin says: “Disconnect only if necessary. Thank you for the tools.”
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-2.tr: Kenarda şöyle yazıyor: “Yalnızca gerekirse ayırın. Aletler için teşekkürler.”

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-3.de: Leg den Mietvertrag daneben. Dieselbe Schleife am E. Die Anleitung und der Dankesbrief tragen Elises Handschrift.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-3.en: Put the lease beside it. The same loop on the E. The manual and thank-you note are in Elise’s handwriting.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-3.tr: Kira sözleşmesini yanına koy. E’nin kıvrımı aynı. Kılavuz ve teşekkür notu Elise’in el yazısıyla yazılmış.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-4.de: Auch ihr Brief hat dieses E. Da hält die Tinte noch. Hier ist sie frisch.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-4.en: Her letter has that E too. The ink still holds there. Here it’s fresh.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-4.tr: Mektubunda da bu E var. Orada mürekkep hâlâ duruyor. Buradaki ise yeni.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-5.de: Deine Caféquittung hat dasselbe E. Der Dank klingt auf beiden Papieren freundlich.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-5.en: Your café receipt has the same E. On both papers, the thanks sound kind.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-5.tr: Kafe fişinde de aynı E var. İki evraktaki teşekkür de dostça görünüyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-6.de: Elise hat den Anschluss getrennt. Mit meiner Zange. Sie lag auf dem Tisch. Ich hörte nichts.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-6.en: Elise disconnected it. With my pliers. They were on the table. I heard nothing.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-6.tr: Bağlantıyı Elise ayırmış. Benim pensimle. Masanın üstündeydi. Hiçbir şey duymadım.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-7.de: Sie hat meine Zange gereinigt. Am Stein fehlt trotzdem ein Name. Was soll ich mit ihrem Danke?
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-7.en: She cleaned my pliers. A name is still missing from the stone. What am I supposed to do with her thanks?
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-7.tr: Pensimi temizlemiş. Ama taşta bir ad hâlâ eksik. Teşekkürüyle ne yapayım?

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-8.de: Der Hebel stoppt die nächste Runde. Aber die Stunde wird überschrieben. Ihre fehlenden Namen müssen wir vorher festhalten.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-8.en: The lever stops the next cycle. But the hour gets overwritten. We must preserve its missing names first.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-8.tr: Kol bir sonraki döngüyü durdurur. Ama o saatin üstüne yenisi yazılır. Kayıp adları önce korumalıyız.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-8:variant.de: Mit dem Hebel endet die Wiederholung. Vorher müssen wir die Namen aus der fehlenden Stunde festhalten.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-8:variant.en: The lever ends the repetition. First we must preserve the names from the missing hour.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-react-8:variant.tr: Kol tekrarı sona erdirir. Önce kayıp saatteki adları korumalıyız.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-0.de: Stoppen wir die Mühle sofort, oder hält das Dorf erst die Namen fest, bevor diese Stunde verschwindet?
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-0.en: Do we stop the mill now, or let the village preserve the names before this hour disappears?
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-choice-0.tr: Değirmeni hemen durduralım mı, yoksa bu saat kaybolmadan önce köy adları mı korusun?

choice:a2-broken-clock:restore.de: Stoppe die Mühle. Sie soll keinen weiteren Namen nehmen.
choice:a2-broken-clock:restore.en: Stop the mill. It must not take another name.
choice:a2-broken-clock:restore.tr: Değirmeni durdur. Başka bir ad almasın.

choice:a2-broken-clock:consult.de: Zuerst lesen wir alle Namen am Stein. Niemand soll in der fehlenden Stunde bleiben.
choice:a2-broken-clock:consult.en: First we read every name on the stone. Nobody should be left in the missing hour.
choice:a2-broken-clock:consult.tr: Önce taştaki bütün adları okuyalım. Kimse kayıp saatin içinde kalmasın.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-complete-0.de: Greta hat einen Patienten mit Laternenfieber. Er redet von einer Reise, die es nie gab.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-complete-0.tr: Greta'nın fener ateşine yakalanmış bir hastası var. Hiç yapılmamış bir yolculuktan söz ediyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-complete-1.de: Man hat ihn heute Nacht an den alten Schienen gefunden. Er hat auf einen Zug gewartet.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-complete-1.tr: Onu dün gece eski rayların başında bulmuşlar. Bir tren bekliyormuş.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-restore-0.de: Roter Hebel. Jetzt. Die Mühle tickt wieder normal. Zum ersten Mal endet die Stunde.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-restore-0.en: Red lever. Now. The mill is ticking normally again. For the first time, the hour ends.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-restore-0.tr: Kırmızı kol. Şimdi. Değirmen yeniden normal şekilde çalışıyor. İlk kez o saat sona eriyor.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-restore-1.de: Ein Name kommt zurück. Die andere Stelle bleibt glatt. Ich kann mich nicht erinnern, für wen sie war.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-restore-1.en: One name returns. The other patch stays smooth. I can’t remember who it was for.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-restore-1.tr: Bir ad geri geliyor. Öbür yer düz kalıyor. Kimin için olduğunu hatırlayamıyorum.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-consult-0.de: Ich halte die Mühle fest. Ruft Greta. Meine Hände reichen nicht für eine weitere Runde.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-consult-0.en: I’ll hold the mill steady. Get Greta. My hands won’t last another cycle.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-consult-0.tr: Değirmeni tutacağım. Greta’yı çağırın. Ellerim bir döngüye daha dayanmaz.

dialogue:a2-broken-clock-consult-1.de: Wir sind da. Wir lesen die Namen, auch die verblassten. Emil, halte noch einen Augenblick.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-consult-1.en: We’re here. We’ll read the names, even the faded ones. Emil, hold on a moment longer.
dialogue:a2-broken-clock-consult-1.tr: Buradayız. Solmuş olanlar da dâhil, adları okuyacağız. Emil, biraz daha dayan.
